sources.entry: MyFin Budget - Personal finances platform (web + REST API + Android) that'll help you budget, keep track of your income/spending and forecast your financial future. (Demo, Source Code, Clients) GPL-3.0 Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: MyFin is a self-hosted-style personal finance platform for budgeting, tracking income and spending, and forecasting finances, with a React/TypeScript web app and a separate API and Android app.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a web front end built with React and TypeScript for managing personal finances. Users can add transactions manually or import them in batches from the clipboard, either from a .csv file or from a bank's homebanking export. Transactions can be split into two, and accounts are tracked with their balances. Categories and entities segment income and spending, and rules auto-categorize imported transactions. A month-by-month budget tool follows a Boonzi-style approach, and a Stats section shows patrimony evolution and a forecast for coming years. It also includes investment tracking (marked beta), account management, multiple themes, and multilingual support.
how_to_run: Try the demo account (username: demo, password: demo)
Follow the initial setup documentation linked in the README
notable: Batch import from clipboard, CSV, or bank homebanking data
Forecast of patrimony evolution in Stats
Separate REST API and Android client projects
caveats: Investment tracking is currently in beta
Goals and improved account management are roadmap items, not yet available
Described by its author as a passion project, with contributions welcomed by getting in touch rather than a formal contribution process
